## Image 1 — WALKING
**1) Feet vs ground:** ✅ Correct. One foot is planted flat on the platform while the rear foot is lifted mid-stride with a slight arc. The stance foot sits cleanly on the ground line.
**2) Leg anatomy:** ✅ Legs bend naturally, knee of the planted leg flexing forward; no broken joints or reversed knees.
**3) Shadow:** ✅ Soft elliptical shadow directly beneath the character, hugging the ground plane; a reflection below is also consistent with the wet platform. Sensible.

## Image 2 — DASHING (lunge)
**1) Feet vs ground:** ⚠️ Problem. A lunge should be grounded — front foot planted, rear leg trailing. Here **both legs are airborne/off the ground line**, so it reads as a floating pose rather than a ground lunge. Also, the actual ground surface isn't visible in the frame, making it hard to verify contact at all.
**2) Leg anatomy:** ✅ The trailing leg bends at the knee correctly (knee forward, heel kicked back); no glitching limbs.
**3) Shadow:** ❌ **No shadow visible.** For a grounded lunge, a shadow should appear under the stance foot; its absence makes the character look unanchored.

## Image 3 — JUMPING (airborne)
**1) Feet vs ground:** ✅ Correct in that no foot touches the ground — body is fully airborne, legs tucked.
**2) Leg anatomy:** ✅ Same tucked pose as Image 2, knees bend properly, no deformities.
**3) Shadow:** ⚠️ Weak. For a jump you'd expect a **detached shadow on the ground below**, scaled smaller/fainter with height. There's only a very faint blob far beneath at the frame bottom — present but barely readable. Could be strengthened or moved to track the true ground plane.

## Image 4 — LANDING (squash)
**1) Feet vs ground:** ✅ Both feet planted on the ground line with knees bent, absorbing the impact — classic squash-and-stretch landing.
**2) Leg anatomy:** ✅ Deep knee flexion reads naturally; no broken or inverted joints.
**3) Shadow:** ✅ Shadow present directly under the feet, slightly wide/spread — appropriate for a squash frame. Reflection below matches the ground treatment.

### Summary
| Frame | Ground contact | Anatomy | Shadow |
|---|---|---|---|
| Walk | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Dash | ❌ floating, should be grounded | ✅ | ❌ missing |
| Jump | ✅ airborne | ✅ | ⚠️ too faint |
| Land | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

**Key fixes:** ground the dash pose (or add motion trail if it's intentionally a mid-air dash) and add a shadow under the stance foot; boost the jump shadow.
